identityTest.stableIdentity: A bounded authorization to derogate exact architecture rules remains identifiable independently of standards, assessments and risk decisions.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Renewal is a new grant; scope, condition or authority changes never overwrite an effective grant.

invariants: Each exception pins one exact standard expression.
An exception never rewrites assessment outcome.
An exception never amends the standard.
Residual-risk acceptance requires a separate decision.
Missing exception evidence never implies authorization.
Every derogated rule resolves under the one pinned standard expression; derogation across expressions requires separate co-grants.
No grant enters a renewed state and no effective grant's validUntil is edited; renewal is a distinct identity referencing its predecessor.

A grant's validFrom is not earlier than its authorizing decision time, and a renewal's validFrom is not earlier than its predecessor's effective end; concurrent effective grants over the same subject, scope and rule are rejected.
A grant's validity is independent of any assessment; it may exist before the first citing assessment and remains effective after a failed retest until expiry or revocation.
Granting authority, assessing party and subject owner are three distinct parties, and no party holds two of these roles on one grant.
A decision reference resolves the rationale, the authorized occurrence and the issued record; a reference that resolves only the issued record is incomplete.
